label: The Cuban leader has a double and flees with cash
description: The Cuban leader seen with a double who looks like him, then leaving the island with stacks of hundred dollar bills on a boat, flying by Gulfstream to the Dominican Republic and on to Mexico, with Claudia seen taking care of him. Naming the route and the Mexican president who receives him makes this one of the more specific political claims in the corpus.
aliases: he had a double
stacks of hundred-dollar bills
I saw Claudia taking care of him

label: A sandalled foot from heaven crushing the cobra over Cuba
description: A cobra slithering on the land of Cuba and a massive sandalled foot with a hole in it coming out of heaven and crushing the snake's head, after which the glory rises over Cuba. The hole identifies the figure as Christ, which makes this emblematic rather than a described event. Given the same night as the Coachella material.
aliases: a massive foot came out of heaven
it looked like a sandal with a hole in it
smashed that snake's head

label: A meeting where AI says the asteroid will hit, and China plans to deflect it
description: He says he was taken to a meeting with blueprints and equations fed into AI, which said the object will not miss Earth, while the people there talked themselves out of it; then to China, where four scientists in a panic plan to run a rocket into the side of an asteroid, with practice runs promised, and he is told the Chinese are more convinced than the Americans. China's deflection demonstration mission was already public reporting, which he shows on screen in the same breath.
aliases: AI said, This is not going to miss Earth
The Chinese are more convinced than the Americans
run a rocket in the side of an asteroid

label: Four banks holding a rocket down with a lasso against crypto clarity
description: A meeting with bankers on one side and crypto people on the other in which the banks fight against crypto getting clarity, with Chase holding a rocket down by a lasso together with Bank of America and Wells Fargo and BlackRock in the distance, because they did not want to lose what they had. Several of the named banks had already announced custody and stablecoin plans before this, which cuts against the picture.
aliases: They were holding the rocket down and they had a lasso around it
They did not want crypto to have clarity
BlackRock was in the distance

label: Vance comes on the scene after an event, with Erica Kirk consoling America
description: An event after which JD Vance comes on the scene, with Erica Kirk consoling America out of her own experience of losing her husband and acting as a spokesperson because Usha was not there, and a polished man rising up beside her to help. Usha being absent is the detail that makes this a claim about a marriage as well as a presidency.
aliases: I saw J.D. Vance come on the scene
Erica Kirk was consoling America
Usha was not there

label: A device that did not get high enough, sparing the west and hitting the east
description: A device sent up over the Mississippi and fired over Kentucky and Tennessee that did not get high enough, so that Oklahoma, Texas and parts of Florida were spared while the east was badly affected, seen alongside Texas seceding with walls, Oklahoma joining it, and veterans rather than federal agencies protecting the country. A lower burst gives a smaller radius, which is physically consistent.
aliases: But, it didn't get high enough
it really affected the East
I saw veterans. Why?

label: The young investigator exposing California corruption is taken out
description: A California bill proposing a ten thousand dollar fine for exposing corruption, with a young YouTuber doing the exposing rather than politicians, and repeated warnings that he has seen the young man taken out by a deranged person in a way more violent than the Kirk killing, with prayer asked for his safety. Seen more than once and compared to a recent killing, which makes it an unusually direct warning about a living private individual.
aliases: I've seen it more than once now him being taken out
More violent than even a Charlie Kirk
a $10,000 fine if you try to expose it

label: Mike Lindell wins Minnesota by a landslide
description: Prayer that Mike Lindell win Minnesota by a landslide and be blessed, with other godly candidates winning and corruption in Minnesota, California, Texas and Nevada exposed. Minnesota has not elected a Republican to statewide office since 2006, which is the base rate against it.
aliases: pray for Mike Lindell to win by a landslide
He will win Minnesota
We're done with the corruption in Minnesota

label: Cuba falls within a day
description: Cuba seen falling within a day with the task finished and a man used to bring liberty across the land. A single day is a hard bound and one of the sharpest timing claims in the corpus.
aliases: Cuba. It falls within a day
he will finish the task at hand
it will bring liberty across the land

label: A Cold War briefcase from Russia in a Cuban mountain bunker
description: A secret Cold War item from Russia identified as a briefcase which the Cuban leader wants to use, held under a mountain in a fortified bunker with an entrance on the side facing towards America, alongside a purple faced dragon that came up out of the water at Havana three times at night carrying a canister. Suitcase nuclear devices are a persistent claim with no verified example ever produced.
aliases: It's a secret thing. It's a briefcase
It's the side facing towards America
Three times the dragon came up out of the water out of Havana

label: Horns over Cuba and a revival across the Latino nations
description: Horns heard blowing across Cuba three times as a blast with the day of deliverance declared, and a great revival coming to Cuba, Venezuela, Colombia and Brazil, proclaimed for the Latino community as to the children of Israel. Latin American Protestant growth has been continuous for decades, which is the base rate to beat.
aliases: I heard the sounds of the horns
It's the day of deliverance
a great revival is coming to Cuba, to Venezuela, to Colombia

label: Pray over the NBA playoffs starting on the 18th, in Boston and New York
description: The 18th named with prayer over Coachella, the Boston Marathon and the hospitals rather than the Red Cross, and the NBA playoffs starting that day with Boston and New York named specifically. Naming the competition, the date and two cities makes this the most specific security warning of its batch, and all of it passed without incident.
aliases: pray for the NBA playoffs
specifically Boston and New York
they start on the 18th

label: No one will save America but God, and the exalted man is removed
description: He is told there will be no one to save America other than God, that the church did not idolise Obama the way it now idolises this president, and cites Hagin and Wigglesworth that a man is usually removed the moment people look to him as the saviour, adding that a door of pride has been opened and a great shaking follows.
aliases: There will be no one save America other than me
the moment they are usually removed
There's been a door of pride that has been opened
